title: Seeing the Tiny World
vo_lock: Look closer / light-through-glass on the eyepiece, then dive into faceless microbes. Never a photographic camera in the drop.

plates.prompt: Premium 3D cartoon Victorian science study. Brass microscope on polished wood desk, warm lamp, leather books, soft dust motes. Slow push toward the microscope. Silent. No text. No modern equipment. No germs yet.
Premium 3D cartoon glass slide with a glowing bead of pond water. Soft refraction, warm lab light. Slow orbit around the drop. Silent. No cute characters. No cameras.

Premium 3D cartoon close on brass microscope eyepiece. Warm light flares through the lens, subtle spectrum colours. Continuous gentle camera drift. Silent. No text. No faces on any particles. No photographic cameras.

Premium 3D cartoon: the VIEWPOINT dives through the meniscus of a glowing pond-water droplet on a glass slide into a luminous microscopic world. Forward dive the whole clip into faceless teal rods, amber spirals and spiked spheres tumbling in liquid. Biological microbes only. FORBIDDEN: any photographic camera, camcorder, film camera, multi-lens gadget, steampunk camera, floating camera, selfie stick, modern electronics. Do not draw a camera. Silent. No text.

Premium 3D cartoon microbial city inside a water drop: faceless teal rods, amber spirals, spiked spheres drifting and tumbling. Wondrous educational visualisation, slightly ominous. Continuous motion. NO faces NO smiles NO winks. Silent. No cameras.

Premium 3D cartoon: the Explorer boy in teal coat and gold glasses leans into a brass microscope eyepiece, eyes widen in surprise, then startles back a step. Single Explorer only. Continuous acting motion. Attach identity. Silent. No Orbit robot. No cameras in the drop.
Premium 3D cartoon living drop galaxy — sparse-to-rich faceless microbes swirling in luminous water. Continuous gentle camera drift. NO cute faces. Silent. No cameras.
Premium 3D cartoon soft split: left warm Victorian ward corridor (no germ swarm), right glowing microscope light. Gentle parallax. Silent. Period only — no modern hospital. No cameras.

Premium 3D cartoon extreme close on a few faceless glassy bacteria tumbling slowly — rods and spiked spheres only. Deadly educational look. Continuous tumble. NO eyes NO mouths NO smiles. Silent. No cameras.
